"""Append a RECOMMENDATIONS section to the unpacked quarterly_report.docx.

Adds the new section at the end of the document body (before <w:sectPr/>),
reusing the report's existing paragraph formatting (Helvetica Light, sz 24).
"""
import os
import sys

BASE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
SKILL_ROOT = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(BASE, ".codex", "skills", "docx"))
sys.path.insert(0, SKILL_ROOT)

from scripts.document import Document  # noqa: E402

UNPACKED = os.path.join(BASE, "quarterly_report_unpacked")

RPR = ('<w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Helvetica Light" w:hAnsi="Helvetica Light" '
       'w:cs="Helvetica Light"/><w:sz w:val="24"/><w:sz-cs w:val="24"/></w:rPr>')


def para(text=None):
    """One <w:p> matching the report's formatting; empty when text is None."""
    if text is None:
        t = '<w:t xml:space="preserve"/>'
    else:
        t = '<w:t xml:space="preserve">%s</w:t>' % text
    return '<w:p><w:pPr/><w:r>%s%s</w:r></w:p>' % (RPR, t)


def main():
    doc = Document(UNPACKED)
    editor = doc["word/document.xml"]

    if editor.get_node(tag="w:p", contains="RECOMMENDATIONS") is not None:
        print("Recommendations section already present; nothing to do.")
        return

    anchor = editor.get_node(tag="w:p", contains="Key risks include")
    if anchor is None:
        raise SystemExit("Could not locate the closing Risk Factors paragraph.")

    blocks = [
        para("RECOMMENDATIONS"),
        para(),
        para("Based on the strong fourth quarter results and the Q1 2025 outlook, "
             "management recommends the following actions:"),
        para(),
        para("• Continue investing in the Cloud Services segment, the fastest-growing "
             "business line (22.8% YoY), to sustain market share gains and revenue momentum."),
        para("• Extend the operational efficiency programs that lifted operating margin "
             "to 23.1% so that margin expansion continues as the company scales into "
             "international markets."),
        para("• Build on customer acquisition and retention improvements by funding the "
             "initiatives that reduced acquisition costs by 8.3% and increased customer "
             "lifetime value by 14.1%."),
        para("• Maintain hedging strategies and reserve levels to mitigate the currency, "
             "competition, and supply chain risks outlined in the Risk Factors section."),
        para("• Protect research and development investment at 12.8% of revenue to "
             "support the new product launches behind the 10-13% Q1 2025 growth outlook."),
        para(),
    ]

    nodes = editor.insert_after(anchor, blocks[0])
    for block in blocks[1:]:
        nodes = editor.insert_after(nodes[-1], block)

    doc.save()
    print("Added Recommendations section with %d paragraphs." % len(blocks))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
